youtube_meta.title: Three Quarter Town After Dark | Tranquil Village Ambience for Relaxing
youtube_meta.description:
Welcome to Three Quarter Town 🕰️✨

When the amber light spills across the slate roofs, the magic of our unusual town truly awakens. The golden sun goes down, but the sweet hour is never wasted.

Join the little black cat as it takes a quiet stroll across the rooftops, watching the stars appear one by one. Down below, the blacksmith strikes a new match, kindling the spark to push back the dark. 

The old baker checks her warm, steaming bread, and a traveler stops to admire the stone clock tower.

As the river of gold fades, the lanterns glow, and the whole town rests safely under the beautiful night sky. If your world is moving too fast today, stay here for a while. Sit in the warmth of the beautiful flame. You are safe here. 🐈‍⬛🍞
🌌



#ThreeQuarterTown #StopMotion #Claymation #CozyFantasy #TimBurtonStyle #BlackCat #MiniatureTown #RelaxingMusic #SleepAmbience #ShortFilm
